test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'COUNTRY' is written as ‘3-15-21-14-20-18-25' and ‘PEOPLE’ is written as 16-5-15-16-12-5'. How will 'HIGHWAY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Letter is coded as their place value**.

 
• 
 
'COUNTRY' is written as ‘3-15-21-14-20-18-25'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15526163adaace11d32b92e3342a885923a4caec1778662aedeb0c3e7a40301c.png] 
 
• 
 
‘PEOPLE’ is written as 16-5-15-16-12-5'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ada6abaa534420e6a7ef9b87b82ca5141db80b31519e7e4a918485554459435a.png] 
 
• 
 
Similarly, for 'HIGHWAY'**:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e20c5b3abac3f45f6ff3fbe206cac3a7086790c4fc5f2219853c23d79f39b9f.png] 
 
 

 

**​**Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
